titulo: Middle East Live: Tehran targets bases in Jordan and UAE after US strikes Iran for the first time in a month
cuerpo: US forces struck what they described as Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in their first military action in a month on Sunday, breaking a lull in fighting during an intermittent war that has lasted more than six months. In turn Iran struck military bases in Jordan and the UAE on Monday, saying that it was acting in legitimate self-defence. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
